text:
anna: Heads up — CI on main is red after the poetry lock regen pushed earlier. Integration suite failing in redis-related tests (redis pool/socket errors). Saw the failure on the nightly job: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/12345 :eyes:
ci-bot: Build #12345 failed — integration-tests (linux) — logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/12345/logs
raj: Re-ran the job manually, same failure. Probably not flakey. Which lock bump touched redis deps?
anna: Lock regen was automated by dependabot-style job. Commit e7b3a2f updated transitive redis-py from 4.5.3 -> 5.0.0 and bumped aioredis->redis.asyncio mapping. I suspect breaking change in pooling API.
maria: Quick glance at the log: connection pool raising socket timeout during setup, stack shows import path with redis.asyncio. Paste of top of error:
```
  File "/opt/runner/work/repo/integration/tests/test_redis_pool.py", line 42, in setup
    self.pool = await create_redis_pool(url)
  File "/home/runner/.pyenv/versions/3.10.12/lib/python3.10/site-packages/redis/asyncio/client.py", line 210, in create_redis_pool
    raise TypeError("create_redis_pool got unexpected kwarg 'connection_class'")
TypeError: create_redis_pool got unexpected kwarg 'connection_class'
```
raj: That matches a signature change in redis 5.0 — our wrapper passes connection_class expecting older API. Two options: revert lock or adapt code. Since this is a regression from lock regen, let's bisect the lockfile to find exact transitive bump.
anna: Can someone run a lockfile bisect? I don't have cycles atm. If it's a single transitive bump we can pin redis to 4.5.x until we upgrade code.
devops-bot: Created issue #INC-789 and assigned eng-infra. Bisect helper: use `scripts/lock-bisect --from-lock e7b3a2f --to-lock HEAD --test 'pytest integration/tests/test_redis_pool.py::TestPool::test_setup -q'`
raj: Running the bisect locally now. Will post results in a few mins.
raj: Bisect found the culprit: transitive bump from redis 4.5.3 -> 5.0.0 introduced change. Patch commit in package index: redis-py@5.0.0.
maria: Ok, quick mitigation: revert the lock change for redis and pin to 4.5.3 in pyproject.lock / constraints. I'll open a PR with lockfile revert + note.
anna: Please add a changelog note and link to the failing tests so we can follow up later to upgrade code. Also tag @product for risk note.
maria: PR opened: https://git.redwood/internal/pulls/456 (revert lock bump + pin redis==4.5.3). CI triggered.
ci-bot: Build #12347 triggered by PR 456 — integration-tests queued.
raj: Local repro with redis 4.5.3 succeeds, tests pass. Will run full suite to be safe.
maria: CI for PR 456 is green on the integration job — merging.
anna: Thanks everyone. After merge I'll cut a quick postmortem note and add a follow-up ticket to update our redis wrapper to be compatible with redis-py 5.x (compat shim or code change) — assigning to raj.
raj: Will take the follow-up. Will also add a small compatibility test to catch signature changes in future lock regens.
maria: Filing follow-up ticket ENG-2342 with details and link to bisect output.
anna: Closing this thread — revert fixed the pipeline. :white_check_mark:
